title: Marigold: a machine learning-based web app for zebrafish pose tracking.
summary: Marigold’s learned pose-tracking network enabled two zebrafish behavior experiments; the Results report genotype-by-touch-location escape differences and feeding-by-developmental-stage visuomotor differences.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models integrate clinical and radiomic features to predict outcome after post-thrombectomy imaging.
organization: Biology Department, University of Massachusetts Amherst, Amherst, MA, USA

evidence.tested: Marigold’s learned pose-tracking network enabled two zebrafish behavior experiments; the Results report genotype-by-touch-location escape differences and feeding-by-developmental-stage visuomotor differences.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
